tools.name: upkeep_get_account
tools.description: Confirm the UpKeep API token is active: returns the company id, the token's name, when it was created and when it was last used. GET /api/v1/organization-api-tokens/introspect.

tools.name: upkeep_list_work_orders
tools.description: List work orders (reactive and preventive), newest first, with status, priority, due date, asset, location, assignee, parts, time and cost. Filter by status, completion, priority, category, asset, location, assignee, title or date ranges. GET /work-orders.

tools.name: upkeep_get_work_order
tools.description: One work order by id with its checklist items, custom fields, time log, parts and files. GET /work-orders/{id}.

tools.name: upkeep_list_assets
tools.description: List assets (equipment) with name, model, serial and barcode, location, status, downtime status, warranty and number of open work orders. Filter by name, serial number, barcode, location, status, category or assignee. GET /assets.

tools.name: upkeep_get_asset
tools.description: One asset by id with purchase and warranty details, custom fields and (optionally) assigned users, teams, vendors, parts, files and sub-assets. GET /assets/{id}.

tools.name: upkeep_list_locations
tools.description: List locations (sites, buildings, rooms) with address, barcode, parent location and hierarchy level. GET /locations.

tools.name: upkeep_get_location
tools.description: One location by id. GET /locations/{id}.

tools.name: upkeep_list_parts
tools.description: List spare parts with quantity on hand, minimum quantity, cost, category, location and part number. Compare quantity with minimumQuantity to find parts to reorder. GET /parts.

tools.name: upkeep_get_part
tools.description: One part by id with quantity, cost, location and custom fields. GET /parts/{id}.

tools.name: upkeep_list_meters
tools.description: List meters (usage counters such as hours, mileage, temperature) with units, reading frequency and the asset or location they belong to. GET /meters.

tools.name: upkeep_get_meter
tools.description: One meter by id. GET /meters/{id}.

tools.name: upkeep_list_meter_readings
tools.description: Readings recorded for one meter (value, date, who recorded it), newest first. GET /meters/{id}/readings.

tools.name: upkeep_add_meter_reading
tools.description: WRITE: record a new reading on a meter (for example engine hours or mileage). A reading cannot be removed with this server, and a meter notification can create a work order automatically when its condition is met. POST /meters/{id}/readings.

tools.name: upkeep_list_requests
tools.description: List work requests submitted by staff or through the request portal (before they become work orders), with status open/approved/rejected. GET /requests.

tools.name: upkeep_get_request
tools.description: One work request by id with its form fields and, once approved, the linked work order id. GET /requests/{id}.

tools.name: upkeep_create_request
tools.description: WRITE: submit a new work request for the maintenance team to approve (it appears in UpKeep's Requests list and may notify the approvers or the assignee). It is not a work order until approved. If the account has a request form configured, pass its field labels in `fields`. POST /requests.

tools.name: upkeep_approve_request
tools.description: WRITE: approve a pending work request, which converts it into a work order (it may notify the assignee). Needs a token whose role may approve requests. Approving a request that is already approved or declined fails with HTTP 409. POST /requests/{id}/approve.

tools.name: upkeep_create_work_order
tools.description: WRITE: create a new work order (it may notify the assignee and appears in UpKeep's work order board). Ids for asset, location and assignee come from the list tools. POST /work-orders.

tools.name: upkeep_update_work_order
tools.description: WRITE: change fields of an existing work order: status (open, onHold, inProgress, complete), title, description, priority, due date or assignee. Only the fields you pass change; completing a work order may trigger the account's integrations (for example Zapier). Archiving and deleting are not offere

tools.name: upkeep_add_work_order_message
tools.description: WRITE: post a message (comment) on a work order's activity thread; people following the work order may be notified. POST /work-orders/{id}/update-messages.

tools.name: upkeep_update_part_quantity
tools.description: WRITE: set the quantity on hand (and optionally the minimum quantity that triggers a low-stock notification) of a part. This overwrites the stored number: read the part first and pass the new total, not the difference. PATCH /parts/{id}.

tools.name: upkeep_list_users
tools.description: List UpKeep users (technicians, admins, requesters) with account type, job title, status and last login. Use the ids to assign work orders. GET /users.

tools.name: upkeep_get_user
tools.description: One user by id. GET /users/{id}.

tools.name: upkeep_list_teams
tools.description: List teams with name and description. Use the ids to assign work. GET /teams.

tools.name: upkeep_list_vendors
tools.description: List vendors (suppliers and contractors) with contact details. GET /vendors.

tools.name: upkeep_list_customers
tools.description: List customers (the parties whose assets or locations you maintain) with contact details. GET /customers.

tools.name: upkeep_list_purchase_orders
tools.description: List purchase orders with status (awaiting, approved, declined, fulfilled), vendor, dates, total cost and quantities. GET /purchase-orders.

tools.name: upkeep_get_purchase_order
tools.description: One purchase order by id with its parts, quantities, costs and shipping details. GET /purchase-orders/{id}.

tools.name: upkeep_list_preventive_maintenance
tools.description: List preventive maintenance (PM) templates, the recurring work that generates scheduled work orders, with their schedules. Filter by text, asset, location, assignee, team or priority. Pages are 1-based. GET /pm.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: upkeep_create_request, upkeep_create_work_order, upkeep_update_part_quantity · Private data: upkeep_get_account, upkeep_get_work_order, upkeep_get_asset, upkeep_add_meter_reading, upkeep_approve_request, upkeep_list_vendors, upkeep_list_customers · Public sink: upkeep_add_meter_reading, upkeep_create_request, upkeep_approve_request, upkeep_create_work_order, upkeep_add_work_order_message.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: upkeep_create_request, upkeep_create_work_order, upkeep_update_part_quantity · Private data: upkeep_get_account, upkeep_get_work_order, upkeep_get_asset, upkeep_add_meter_reading, upkeep_approve_request, upkeep_list_vendors, upkeep_list_customers · Public sink: upkeep_add_meter_reading, upkeep_create_request, upkeep_approve_request, upkeep_create_work_order, upkeep_add_work_order_message

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
